interface.name: rin_glass_shape_manager_v1

description.summary: exact glass shapes for background effects

interface.description:
A client that draws its surfaces as one signed-distance field (rounded bodies joined by smooth unions, optionally inside a frame band) gives the compositor that field, so the compositor's blur and lens follow the client's own silhouette exactly instead of a region of rectangles.
The shape only shapes a background effect: the surface also needs an ext_background_effect_surface_v1 blur region, which switches the effect on and stays the fallback where the compositor cannot use the shape.

entry.summary: the surface already has a rin_glass_shape_v1 object

description.summary: get the glass shape object of a surface

request.description: Create the glass shape object of a surface. A surface has at most one.

interface.name: rin_glass_shape_v1

description.summary: the glass shape of one surface

interface.description: The shape is double-buffered state, applied on the next wl_surface.commit. Destroying the object unsets the shape on the next commit.

entry.name: invalid_field
entry.summary: the field array does not follow the layout

description.summary: unset the shape and destroy the object

request.name: set_field

description.summary: set the signed-distance field of the surface

request.description:
The array holds native-endian 32-bit floats. An empty array unsets the shape.
It starts with 14 numbers: origin x, origin y, scale, width, height, framed (0 or 1), joins frame (0 or 1), band, corner, wave left, wave top, wave right, wave bottom, wave clock. A point of the field at (fx, fy) is at origin + scale * (fx, fy) in surface-local logical coordinates. Width and height are the field's own size.
11 numbers follow for each body: x, y, width, height, the corner radii (top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left), fuse, first join and second join. A join is 0 for none, -1 for the frame and n for the body at n - 1. A body joined to another melts into it by a polynomial smooth union of width fuse. A body's corners are quartic superellipses over 1.8409 times the radius.
When framed, the frame is the outside of the rounded box inset by band, with corner radius corner; its inner line swells by wave on each side, with phase wave clock. The compositor uses at most 24 bodies.
